---
title: "Neighborhood Health Explorer"
format: html
editor: visual
---

## Explore neighborhood health data

This website explores data around the Duwamish River. Use the layer selector to switch between maps; each map's legend appears only while it is selected.

```{r, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(sf)
library(leaflet)
library(htmlwidgets)
library(dplyr)
# ---- Load data -------------------------------------------------------------
map_data    <- readRDS("map_data.rds")
tracts_local <- readRDS("tracts_local.rds")

# NOTE: `king_county` (sf polygon) and `king_county_life_expectancy` (number)
# were used in the original file but are not in the uploaded .rds files.
# Load or define them here, e.g.:
king_county <- st_read("./Data/king_county_shp/King_County_Political_Boundary_(no_waterbodies).shp") |>
  st_make_valid() |>
  st_transform(4326) |>
  summarise(geometry = st_union(geometry))
king_county <- king_county |>
  mutate(
    king_county_le = kc_le
  )
king_county_life_expectancy <- read_csv('./Data/life_expectancy_king_county.csv')$life_expectancy_king_county[[2]]
   # <- replace with your value

# Leaflet needs WGS84 lon/lat
map_data     <- st_transform(map_data, 4326)
tracts_local <- st_transform(tracts_local, 4326)
king_county  <- st_transform(king_county, 4326)

# ---- Palettes --------------------------------------------------------------
pal_asthma <- colorNumeric(
  palette = "YlOrRd",
  domain = map_data$children_asthma_hosp_rateper100k,
  na.color = "#cccccc"
)

pal_life <- colorNumeric(
  palette = rev(hcl.colors(9, "Purples")),
  domain = map_data$life_expect_est,
  na.color = "#cccccc"
)

# Tract map shares one color scale with the King County benchmark
life_values <- c(tracts_local$life_expect_est, king_county_life_expectancy)
pal_life_tract <- colorNumeric(
  palette = "Purples",
  domain = life_values,
  na.color = "#cccccc"
)

# King County asthma benchmark
king_county_rate <- 37.2

# ---- Bounds (used for initial view and when switching layers) --------------
bb_zip   <- st_bbox(map_data)
bb_tract <- st_bbox(tracts_local)

bounds_zip   <- list(lng1 = unname(bb_zip["xmin"]),   lat1 = unname(bb_zip["ymin"]),
                     lng2 = unname(bb_zip["xmax"]),   lat2 = unname(bb_zip["ymax"]))
bounds_tract <- list(lng1 = unname(bb_tract["xmin"]), lat1 = unname(bb_tract["ymin"]),
                     lng2 = unname(bb_tract["xmax"]), lat2 = unname(bb_tract["ymax"]))

# ---- Combined map ----------------------------------------------------------
leaflet() |>
  addTiles() |>

  # 1. Childhood asthma hospitalization rate (ZIP)
  addPolygons(
    data = map_data,
    group = "Asthma",
    fillColor = ~pal_asthma(children_asthma_hosp_rateper100k),
    fillOpacity = 0.75,
    color = "white",
    weight = 1,
    popup = ~paste0(
      "<b>ZIP Code:</b> ", ZCTA5CE20,
      "<br><b>Childhood asthma hospitalization rate:</b> ",
      round(children_asthma_hosp_rateper100k, 1), " per 100,000",
      "<br><b>King County comparison:</b> 37.2 per 100,000",
      "<br><b>Difference from county rate:</b> ",
      ifelse(
        is.na(children_asthma_hosp_rateper100k),
        "Not available",
        paste0(
          ifelse(children_asthma_hosp_rateper100k - king_county_rate > 0, "+", ""),
          round(children_asthma_hosp_rateper100k - king_county_rate, 1),
          " per 100,000"
        )
      )
    )
  ) |>

  # 2. Life expectancy (ZIP)
  addPolygons(
    data = map_data,
    group = "Life Expectancy",
    fillColor = ~pal_life(life_expect_est),
    fillOpacity = 0.75,
    color = "white",
    weight = 1,
    popup = ~paste0(
      "<b>ZIP Code:</b> ", ZCTA5CE20,
      "<br><b>Life expectancy:</b> ", round(life_expect_est, 1), " years"
    )
  ) |>

  # 3. Life expectancy: Georgetown & South Park tracts vs. King County
  addPolygons(
    data = king_county,
    group = "Life Expectancy (Tracts)",
    fillColor = ~pal_life_tract(king_county_life_expectancy),
    fillOpacity = 0.7,
    color = "#333333",
    weight = 2,
    popup = ~paste0(
      "<b>King County life expectancy:</b> ",
      round(king_county_life_expectancy, 1), " years"
    )
  ) |>
  addPolygons(
    data = tracts_local,
    group = "Life Expectancy (Tracts)",
    fillColor = ~pal_life_tract(life_expect_est),
    fillOpacity = 1,
    color = "white",
    weight = 1.5,
    popup = ~paste0(
      "<b>Census tract:</b> ", `Geography Name`,
      "<br><b>Life expectancy:</b> ", round(life_expect_est, 1), " years"
    ),
    highlightOptions = highlightOptions(
      weight = 3, color = "#333333", bringToFront = TRUE
    )
  ) |>

  # Legends: each gets its own CSS class so JavaScript can show/hide it
  addLegend(
    position = "bottomright",
    pal = pal_asthma,
    values = map_data$children_asthma_hosp_rateper100k,
    title = paste0(
      "Childhood asthma hospitalizations<br>per 100,000<br>",
      "<span style='font-size:12px;color:#333'>King County: 37.2</span>"
    ),
    className = "info legend legend-asthma"
  ) |>
  addLegend(
    position = "bottomright",
    pal = pal_life,
    values = map_data$life_expect_est,
    title = "Life expectancy (years)",
    className = "info legend legend-life"
  ) |>
  addLegend(
    position = "bottomright",
    pal = pal_life_tract,
    values = life_values,
    title = "Life expectancy (years)",
    opacity = 1,
    className = "info legend legend-tract"
  ) |>

  # King County benchmark box (belongs to the tract map)
  addControl(
    html = paste0(
      "<div style='background:white; padding:10px 14px; ",
      "border-radius:5px; box-shadow:0 1px 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);'>",
      "<b>King County comparison</b><br>",
      round(king_county_life_expectancy, 1), " years</div>"
    ),
    position = "topright",
    className = "leaflet-control legend-tract"
  ) |>

  # Layer selector
  addLayersControl(
    baseGroups = c("Asthma", "Life Expectancy", "Life Expectancy (Tracts)"),
    options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
  ) |>

  fitBounds(bounds_zip$lng1, bounds_zip$lat1, bounds_zip$lng2, bounds_zip$lat2) |>

  # Show only the legend that matches the selected layer
  onRender(
    "
    function(el, x, data) {
      var map = this;
      var legendFor = {
        'Asthma': 'legend-asthma',
        'Life Expectancy': 'legend-life',
        'Life Expectancy (Tracts)': 'legend-tract'
      };

      function showLegend(layerName) {
        Object.keys(legendFor).forEach(function(name) {
          var items = el.querySelectorAll('.' + legendFor[name]);
          items.forEach(function(item) {
            item.style.display = (name === layerName) ? '' : 'none';
          });
        });
      }

      // Initial state: first base layer (Asthma) is selected
      showLegend('Asthma');

      map.on('baselayerchange', function(e) {
        showLegend(e.name);
        var b = (e.name === 'Life Expectancy (Tracts)') ? data.tract : data.zip;
        map.fitBounds([[b.lat1, b.lng1], [b.lat2, b.lng2]]);
      });
    }
    ",
    data = list(zip = bounds_zip, tract = bounds_tract)
  )
```
